from AlgorithmImports import *
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time


class SpyMovingAverageCrossoverCallAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self) -> None:
        self.SetTimeZone(TimeZones.NewYork)
        self.SetStartDate(2023, 4, 1)
        self.SetEndDate(2026, 6, 30)
        self.SetCash(100000)

        equity = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Raw)
        self.spy_symbol = equity.Symbol

        option = self.AddOption("SPY", Resolution.Minute)
        option.SetFilter(-5, 20, 0, 30)
        self.option_symbol = option.Symbol

        self.fast = SimpleMovingAverage(5)
        self.slow = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        self.prev_fast = None
        self.prev_slow = None

        self.invested_contract = None
        self.entry_price = None
        self.entry_ticket = None
        self.exit_ticket = None
        self.no_reentry_date = None

        self.entry_window_start = time(9, 45)
        self.entry_window_end = time(14, 30)

        self.Consolidate(self.spy_symbol, timedelta(minutes=5), self.OnFiveMinuteBar)

        self.Schedule.On(
            self.DateRules.EveryDay(self.spy_symbol),
            self.TimeRules.At(15, 45),
            self.TimeStopCheck
        )

    def OnFiveMinuteBar(self, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        self.fast.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)
        self.slow.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

        if not (self.fast.IsReady and self.slow.IsReady):
            return

        current_fast = self.fast.Current.Value
        current_slow = self.slow.Current.Value

        if self.prev_fast is not None and self.prev_slow is not None:
            if self.prev_fast <= self.prev_slow and current_fast > current_slow:
                self.TryEnter(bar)

        self.prev_fast = current_fast
        self.prev_slow = current_slow

    def TryEnter(self, bar: TradeBar) -> None:
        bar_time = bar.EndTime.time()
        if bar_time < self.entry_window_start or bar_time > self.entry_window_end:
            return
        if self.no_reentry_date == self.Time.date():
            return
        if self.invested_contract is not None or self.IsOrderOpen(self.entry_ticket):
            return

        if self.option_symbol not in self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Skip entry: no option chain in slice")
            return
        chain = self.CurrentSlice.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        contracts = list(chain)
        if not contracts:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Skip entry: option chain empty")
            return

        spy_price = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Price
        current_date = self.Time.date()
        expiries = sorted(set(c.Expiry.date() for c in contracts))
        target_expiry = next((e for e in expiries if (e - current_date).days >= 7), None)
        if target_expiry is None:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Skip entry: no expiration >= 7 calendar days out")
            return

        threshold = spy_price * 1.01
        candidates = [c for c in contracts
                      if c.Right == OptionRight.Call
                      and c.Expiry.date() == target_expiry
                      and c.Strike >= threshold]
        if not candidates:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Skip entry: no call strike >= 101% of SPY at expiry {target_expiry}")
            return

        candidates.sort(key=lambda c: (c.Strike, c.Symbol.Value))
        selected = candidates[0]
        self.entry_ticket = self.MarketOrder(selected.Symbol, 1, tag="Entry")
        self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Entry order submitted: {selected.Symbol.Value} strike={selected.Strike} expiry={target_expiry}")

    def OnData(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if self.invested_contract is not None and not self.Portfolio[self.invested_contract].Invested:
            self.invested_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None

        if self.Portfolio[self.spy_symbol].Invested:
            self.Liquidate(self.spy_symbol, tag="UnexpectedEquityAssignment")
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Unexpected SPY equity position from exercise/assignment; liquidated.")

        if self.invested_contract is not None:
            for delisting in data.Delistings.Values:
                if delisting.Symbol == self.invested_contract:
                    self.Liquidate(self.invested_contract, tag="ExpirationSafetyNet")
                    self.no_reentry_date = self.Time.date()
                    self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Expiration processing reached with open option position; liquidated {self.invested_contract.Value}. No new entry today.")
                    break
            self.CheckProfitTarget(data)

    def CheckProfitTarget(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if self.option_symbol not in data.OptionChains:
            return
        chain = data.OptionChains[self.option_symbol]
        if self.invested_contract not in chain.Contracts:
            return
        contract = chain.Contracts[self.invested_contract]
        bid = contract.BidPrice
        ask = contract.AskPrice
        if bid is None or ask is None or bid <= 0 or ask <= 0:
            return
        mid = (bid + ask) / 2.0
        if mid >= 1.5 * self.entry_price:
            self.TryExit("ProfitTarget")

    def TimeStopCheck(self) -> None:
        if self.invested_contract is None:
            return
        expiry_dt = self.invested_contract.ID.Date
        prev_day = self.GetPreviousTradingDay(expiry_dt)
        if self.Time.date() == prev_day:
            self.TryExit("TimeStop")

    def GetPreviousTradingDay(self, expiry_dt: datetime):
        hours = self.Securities[self.spy_symbol].Exchange.Hours
        candidate = expiry_dt.date() - timedelta(days=1)
        candidate_dt = datetime(candidate.year, candidate.month, candidate.day)
        while not hours.IsDateOpen(candidate_dt):
            candidate_dt -= timedelta(days=1)
        return candidate_dt.date()

    def TryExit(self, reason: str) -> None:
        if self.invested_contract is None:
            return
        if self.IsOrderOpen(self.exit_ticket):
            self.Transactions.CancelOrder(self.exit_ticket.OrderId)
        quantity = self.Portfolio[self.invested_contract].Quantity
        if quantity == 0:
            return
        self.exit_ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.invested_contract, -quantity, tag=reason)
        self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Exit order submitted ({reason}): {self.invested_contract.Value}")

    def OnOrderEvent(self, orderEvent: OrderEvent) -> None:
        if orderEvent.Status != OrderStatus.Filled:
            return
        symbol = orderEvent.Symbol
        if self.entry_ticket is not None and orderEvent.OrderId == self.entry_ticket.OrderId:
            self.invested_contract = symbol
            self.entry_price = orderEvent.FillPrice
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Entry filled: {symbol.Value} @ {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
            return
        if symbol == self.invested_contract and orderEvent.FillQuantity < 0:
            self.Debug(f"{self.Time} Exit filled: {symbol.Value} @ {orderEvent.FillPrice:.2f}")
            self.invested_contract = None
            self.entry_price = None
            self.entry_ticket = None
            self.exit_ticket = None

    def IsOrderOpen(self, ticket: OrderTicket) -> bool:
        if ticket is None:
            return False
        return ticket.Status not in (OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid)
